usage: Usually refers to the pinkish metal finish used in rings, watches, phones, and accessories; it sounds natural in everyday shopping and fashion talk.
Often used as an attributive noun before another noun, so it commonly describes the item’s material or color tone rather than standing alone.
In Hong Kong, this term is more common in product descriptions and retail settings than in casual slang; it feels neutral and clear.
Good learner tip: use it when you want to talk about the metal color, not the gemstone itself; it pairs well with jewellery-related nouns.
